title: Proofs of Prophethood 16: Prophecy of Return to Makkah
normalized_text: welcome back to another video and the proofs of profited series in this specific video i'm going to be talking about the prophecy of the return of the prophet peace be upon him to makkah the prophet peace be upon him was forced to leave makkah because of the oppression that he faced and then these verses were revealed indeed he who imposed upon you the quran will take you back to a place of return the place of return mentioned in the verse is ma'ad which ibn abbas refers to as makkah adds to it another verse for more of a context and mentioned when we made the house a place of return for the people and a place of security and i'd personally like to add another verse of my own to give this more clarity certainly allah showed to his messenger the vision in truth you will surely enter al-masid al-haram if allah wills in safety with your heads shaved and hair shortened not fearing anyone he knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near at hand a pretty straightforward prophecy the prophet peace upon him was oppressed in mecca for 13 years and at that time it was not a prophecy that seemed likely to come to pass however it was a prophecy that was made and a few years before his death not only did he return to mecca but he actually conquered mecca performed umrah performed the pilgrimage now that is a prophecy that came to pass see you guys in the next one assalamualaikum about
